state.question: For Linden Treasury, what do the latest records show about auction demand? Please resolve this specific point: October bid coverage and the change from September, using the same auction maturity.
state.gap: October bid coverage and the change from September, using the same auction maturity.

I treated the announcement as a starting point and followed the measurement boundary through the reporting period.

The Treasury auction register reports ten-year bid coverage of 2.6 on 6 October versus 2.1 on 8 September; coverage rose by 0.5.

Background to the observation: The Treasury announced an October ten-year auction of 4 billion crowns.

The figures belong to the stated population and reporting dates. Extending them to another operator would require a separate observation. A count of installations and a count of successful outcomes use different denominators.
